question: Should Andrographis paniculata be recommended for: symptomatic relief of uncomplicated acute upper respiratory tract infection (cough, sore throat)?

records.notes: Meta-analysis pooling 33 randomized trials (7,175 patients) found Andrographis paniculata significantly reduced cough and sore throat severity compared with placebo, but the authors and prior reviews (Coon & Ernst 2004; Poolsup et al. 2004) note persistent concerns about trial quality, missing manufacturing detail, and high heterogeneity across studies.
records.source_title: Andrographis paniculata for symptomatic relief of acute respiratory tract infections in adults and children: a systematic review and meta-analysis
records.study_design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs
records.target_indication: symptomatic relief of uncomplicated acute upper respiratory tract infection (cough, sore throat)
records.primary_outcome: symptomatic relief of uncomplicated acute upper respiratory tract infection (cough, sore throat)
